independent_geometry.centroid_definition: Unweighted arithmetic mean of Cartesian positions of the named ring atoms; fractional positions transformed using the measured cell.
independent_geometry.plane_definition: Least-squares plane through each ring centroid; normal is the smallest-eigenvalue eigenvector of the centered Cartesian coordinate scatter matrix.
independent_geometry.to_outside_plane_definition: abs(dot(c2_transformed - c1, n2_transformed)); distance of original isoxazole centroid to transformed phenyl plane.
independent_geometry.to_inside_plane_definition: abs(dot(c2_transformed - c1, n1)); distance of transformed phenyl centroid to original isoxazole plane.
independent_geometry.nonparallel_plane_boundary: The ring planes are tilted. The two centroid-to-plane distances differ; neither is a unique distance between infinite nonparallel planes.

native_packing_cross_check.quantity_warning: packing.json plane_separation_A projects onto the INSIDE isoxazole normal (3.4702085 A), not the outside phenyl normal; use ring_audit for both definitions.

independent_geometry.digits_boundary: Digits are preserved from the recorded calculation, not experimentally established precision. Coordinate/cell uncertainty was not propagated; no acceptance tolerance or statistical error bar is inferred.
